desc:
🦆 Hunt ducks with your dog and become the richest! 🤑

⚔️ Equip your weapon
🐶 Prepare your dog
🦆 Shoot ducks
💰 Sell your ducks and upgrade
🤑 Become the richest!

Shoutout to: 1 Billion Ducks on steam! This game is inspired by them. Go check it out!

Controls

🖥️ PC: Left Click / R / E / Esc
🎮 Console: RT / X / A / B
📱 Mobile: Use the on-screen buttons for shooting, reloading, interacting, and navigating menus.

🚧 The game is still in beta, and we’re improving it every day!

Enjoy the game! Feel free to leave a like and join the group to support us! 👍
